陈洛兮赶紧走到王野身边小声点说：“王野，对不起啊！我也不知道这么多人。这些都是我大哥的朋友。你能不能看我的面子先进去呀？”

陈少峰见自家妹妹去跟王野说悄悄话，火气顿时就上来了，后槽牙咬的“咯咯”作响。

王野看着陈洛兮一脸歉意的样子，也知道不能怪她，长出一口气，跟着陈洛兮进了院子。

秦天熙等了一下，当王野走到他身边时说：“王野兄弟，别在意啊！这都是我和少峰的朋友，很久不见了，正好今天聚一聚。”

王野见这架势也不客气了，冷着脸说：“我可没准备这些人的吃食。”

秦天熙见王野口气不善，就说：“少峰准备了，不用王野兄弟操心。但是如果王野兄弟可以给做一下就更好了。”

王野可不是陈洛兮雇的厨师，听着秦天熙这话脸上更冷了，说：“我认识他们是谁呀？给他们做饭？”

要不说有人就是不长眼呢！就在王野和秦天熙说话时，一个瘦高个儿看见来了一个不认识的人，而且王野的背篓里还有鸡鸭鱼，以为是找来的厨师，就大声的说：“你就是峰哥找来的厨师吧？我带你去厨房。你赶紧做饭，兄弟们都饿了。”

说完就要上前去拉王野，听到这句话的王野怒气值已经升到了极点，再加上陈少峰就在那里插着手笑嘻嘻的看着。陈洛兮刚要上前解释，就被王野一把拉了回来。

秦天熙见王野把陈洛兮拉了回来，也就没有上前。

王野冷冷的说：“你哪只眼睛看我像厨师？”

这一句话把全院子人的目光都吸引过来了，紧接着所有人都围了过来，瘦高个儿说：“小子，你是谁家的？说话这么冲！”

王野轻哼了一声说：“怎么？我要是大人物家的，你就给我道歉了？”

王野这种嘲讽的话语，一下就激怒了瘦高个，挽起袖子就要动手，被一个青年拦了下来。

这人看陈洛兮和王野一起，应该是友非敌，就说：“兄弟误会了，看你应该是洛兮的朋友，我这兄弟误会你了，我替他给你道个歉，但是你这说话的态度可不太友善呀，是不是也该给我这兄弟道个歉呀？”

王野开始见人出来做和事佬了，也想就此揭过。可是让他道歉就有点不高兴了，微微一笑说：“我要是不道歉呢？”

那人见王野给台阶都不下，也有点生气了就说：“那我就叫人教教你怎么说话。”

王野把手里的小丫头转身递给陈洛兮，陈洛兮刚要说什么，就被王野的眼神制止了。

王野走到墙边把背篓摘下，小心翼翼的放下，这里可都是好东西，万一一会儿起冲突打坏了，王野还是有点儿心疼的。

王野慢悠悠的走回刚才的位置，漫不经心的说：“教吧，我看看谁能教我说话。”

那青年看王野的样子更生气了，对着人群喊了一声：“强子，过来教教这小子怎么说话！”

话音刚落，就从人群后面过来一个壮汉，王野看着这汉子，立刻就想到了鸽子市的龙哥和强子。王野每次去鸽子市都是蒙着面的，龙哥和强子也是。看样子这个青年就是鸽子市龙哥，叫出来的壮汉，就是他的跟班强子了。

就强子这体格，王野觉得肯定不会认错。强子出来一句话都没说，挥拳就奔着王野过来。就强子的大体格子，好像一头黑熊迎面扑来。要是一般人早被吓得不敢动了。

可是王野是一般人吗？不是。他现在可是明劲高层的高手。王野嘴角上扬，迎着强子就撞了上去，左手挡开强子的拳头，一击铁山靠结结实实的撞在了强子胸口。

强子那二百多斤的身体直接倒飞出去两米多，撞在一棵院里的树上才停下。王野可没就此收手，紧跟着一击猛虎硬爬山直奔强子脑门。

Chen Luoxi quickly walked to Wang Ye and whispered: "Wang Ye, I'm sorry! I didn't know there were so many people. These are my eldest brother's friends. Can you go in first for my sake?"

When Chen Shaofeng saw his sister whispering to Wang Ye, he immediately became angry and gritted his molar teeth.

Wang Ye looked at Chen Luoxi's apologetic look and knew he couldn't blame her. He let out a sigh of relief and followed Chen Luoxi into the yard.

Qin Tianxi waited for a while, and when Wang Ye walked up to him, he said, "Brother Wang Ye, don't worry about it! These are all friends of Shaofeng and I. We haven't seen each other for a long time. We just want to get together today."

Seeing this attitude, Wang Ye became unkind and said with a cold face: "I didn't prepare food for these people."

When Qin Tianxi saw Wang Ye's bad tone, he said, "Shaofeng is ready. Brother Wang Ye doesn't need to worry about it. But it would be better if brother Wang Ye could do it."

Wang Ye was not the chef hired by Chen Luoxi. Hearing Qin Tianxi's words, his face became even colder and he said, "Who do I know they are? Cook for them?"

Otherwise, some people just don’t have eyesight!Just when Wang Ye and Qin Tianxi were talking, a tall and thin man saw an unknown person coming, and there were chickens, ducks and fish in Wang Ye's backpack. He thought it was the chef he had hired, so he said loudly: "You are the chef Brother Feng has hired, right? I'll take you to the kitchen. You hurry up and cook, the brothers are all hungry."

After saying this, he was about to step forward to pull Wang Ye away. After hearing this, Wang Ye's anger level had risen to the extreme. In addition, Chen Shaofeng was standing there with his hands in his hands and watching with a smile.Just as Chen Luoxi was about to step forward to explain, Wang Ye pulled her back.

Qin Tianxi saw Wang Ye pulling Chen Luoxi back, so he didn't step forward.

Wang Ye said coldly: "Which of your eyes thinks I look like a chef?"

This sentence attracted the attention of everyone in the courtyard, and then everyone gathered around. The tall and thin man said: "Boy, whose family are you from? You speak so rudely!"

Wang Ye snorted and said, "What? If I belonged to a big shot, would you have apologized to me?"

Wang Ye's mocking words immediately angered the tall and thin man. He rolled up his sleeves and was about to take action, but was stopped by a young man.

Seeing that Chen Luoxi and Wang Ye were together, this person said, "Brother, I have misunderstood. It seems that you are Luo Xi's friend. My brother has misunderstood you. I apologize to you on his behalf, but your attitude in speaking is not very friendly. Shouldn't you also apologize to my brother?"

Wang Ye began to see people acting as peacemakers, and wanted to expose them.But he was a little unhappy when he was asked to apologize. He smiled slightly and said, "What if I don't apologize?"

Seeing that Wang Ye couldn't even walk down the steps, the man got a little angry and said, "Then I'll ask someone to teach you how to speak."

Wang Ye turned around and handed the little girl in his hand to Chen Luoxi. Chen Luoxi was about to say something but was stopped by Wang Ye's eyes.

Wang Ye walked to the wall, took off the backpack, and put it down carefully. There were all good things here. If there was a conflict and it was broken, Wang Ye would still feel a little distressed.

Wang Ye slowly walked back to where he was before and said casually: "Teach me, let's see who can teach me how to speak."

The young man became even more angry when he saw Wang Ye, and shouted to the crowd: "Qiangzi, come here and teach this kid how to speak!"

As soon as he finished speaking, a strong man came from behind the crowd. Wang Ye looked at this man and immediately thought of Brother Long and Qiangzi from Pigeon Market.Wang Ye always covered his face every time he went to Pigeon Market, as did Brother Long and Qiangzi.It seemed that this young man was Brother Long from Pigeon City, and the strong man he called out was his follower Qiangzi.

With Qiangzi's physique, Wang Ye felt that he would definitely not admit his mistake.Qiangzi didn't say a word when he came out, and rushed towards Wang Ye with a fist pump.Just the general grid of hadrons looks like a black bear rushing towards you.Ordinary people would have been too frightened to move.

But is Wang Ye an ordinary person?no.He is now a master of Mingjin's senior management.The corner of Wang Ye's mouth raised, and he bumped into Qiangzi. He blocked Qiangzi's fist with his left hand, and hit Qiangzi's chest firmly with the iron mountain support.

Qiangzi's body of more than 200 kilograms flew backwards for more than two meters and stopped after hitting a tree in the yard.Wang Ye didn't stop there, and followed up with a powerful attack from the tiger that climbed up the mountain and went straight to Qiangzi's head.
